adapter_gap.root_cause: The adapter hard-codes stale numeric-code-to-certification mappings and applies the two page-wide round headings to every row. The live table labels and PDF headings are authoritative and contradict all 30 retained assignments.

probe_policy.declared_scope: The official rolling download page only: every currently listed question/answer row, using each PDF's embedded year and round when those disagree with the page-wide recent-round headings.

legal_and_technical.download_notice: SFI explicitly offers the previous two written-test seasons' questions and selected-answer PDFs for download.
legal_and_technical.rights_notice: SFI's privacy/intellectual-property notice says website software, files, information, and other content are owned by SFI or other rights holders; no exam-PDF republication license was found.
legal_and_technical.robots_result: HTTP 200 redirects to /NotFound HTML; no robots policy is published at that path.

publication_risk.manifest_agreement_warning: Bundle/site/frontend/release metadata agree with the incorrect normalized identities and therefore do not detect this defect.

probe_policy.rolling_slot_warning: Download/01 and Download/02 are mutable presentation slots, not immutable historical identifiers. Event identity must be parsed from the PDF payload and the row label; a URL or numeric code alone is insufficient.
